text:
deploybot: Deploybot paused rollout for release v2.14.0 (slot 42) due to incident: repeated 503s from eu-control-plane. Auto-quarantine engaged at 11:03 UTC.
jen.lee: copy. what's the impact surface?
mike.k: seeing increased kvcache miss rate + 503s in eu-prod, mirror of earlier spike. is this a rollback candidate or just hold-and-monitor? :thinking_face:
ops-oncall: investigating logs now, looks like control-plane auth errors hitting our token service. engineers oncall running auth-service postmortem checks. ETA ~20–30m.
release-manager: let's not automatically roll back if it's a control-plane auth issue; we should pin the deploy and reschedule the remaining slots. can someone pin v2.14.0 to avoid partial rollouts?
dave: I can pin the version in deploy config. doing: `deployctl pin release --version v2.14.0 --slot 42`
jen.lee: perfect — pin and hold. we should notify customers if this pushes their change window. release-manager, can you update release notes + status page?
release-manager: will update status page and the release notes draft. adding note: "Rollout paused for v2.14.0 due to control-plane auth incident; will reschedule remaining canaries." linking ops ticket #INC-8421.
mike.k: if ops determines it's caused by our last edge change, we might need a rollback. can we prep rollback steps and a hotfix branch now?
ashley: created hotfix branch `hotfix/auth-timeout-2026-03-21`. testing quick config rollback now.
deploybot: Rollout paused (slot 42). Autoscale/traffic rebalanced to stable-stable. Canary traffic redirected.
ops-oncall: root cause looks upstream in token-service; not related to runtime change. ops will continue monitoring. still ~15m for mitigation confirmation.
dave: pinned and added hold reason: "INC-8421 auth errors". also set deploy tag `hold/INC-8421`.
jen.lee: OK, new plan: hold current rollout, do not rollback for now, reschedule remaining slots to the next maintenance window (2026-03-22 02:00 UTC). release-manager, schedule reschedule notice and notify PLs.
release-manager: scheduled. drafting customer-facing blurb and internal changelog entry. assigning followup checklist to @ashley and @dave.
mike.k: prepping rollback command just in case. tagging here so SRE has it:
```
# rollback to v2.13.7
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.14.0 --to-version v2.13.7 --force
```
ashley: tested rollback dry-run in staging. no surprises. ops can execute if we confirm cause ties to app change.
incident-bot: INC-8421 updated: control-plane token-service degraded; mitigation in progress; next update in 10m.
jen.lee: thanks. once ops confirms not application-related, we proceed with reschedule. otherwise, execute rollback plan. please add final signoff here before any rollback. :eyes:
ops-oncall: mitigation confirmed (token service patched). metrics falling back to baseline. recommend lifting hold and resuming a slow canary or rescheduling to agreed window?
release-manager: since customers will be impacted by immediate rollouts, we'll reschedule remaining slots to 2026-03-22 02:00 UTC as planned and run a targeted canary of 5% tomorrow at 01:30 UTC for early verification. leaving slot 42 quarantined.
dave: noted. added reschedule annotation in the deploy ticket and bumped priority for the 01:30 canary.
deploybot: Noted. Rollout remains paused for slot 42; next scheduled retry for slot 43 moved to 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z (targeted 5% canary).
jen.lee: let's also add a short postmortem note in the release doc: cause, decision to hold, pinning action, rollback readiness. release-manager can merge after we validate metrics tomorrow.
release-manager: will include all items and close out after canary. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
